description: The worker's five tools in OpenAI chat-completions form, sent as-is in `tools`. Each `parameters` is a JSON Schema that every call's arguments are validated against before the tool runs; a failure is a schema error (docs/escalation.md). The schemas stay plain (no $ref, no regex) because llama-server turns them into a grammar. Paths are relative to the worktree root; the tool layer refuses any path that resolves outside it, symlinks included.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a text file as numbered lines, one page at a time. The reply starts with [lines N-M of TOTAL].

function.name: write
function.description: Create a file or replace all of it. Use for new or small files; use edit for changes to an existing file.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old with new. Fails if old matches nowhere or more than once; then include more surrounding lines.

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command from the worktree root, without network. Output is cut to the last 12 KB of stdout and 4 KB of stderr.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search the worktree's files, tracked and new but not ignored, with an extended regex, as git grep -nE --untracked. Returns at most 100 matching lines as path:line:text.

path.description: File or directory to search. Default: the whole worktree.

glob.description: Only files matching this glob, such as *.py.
